freshness: exec --ephemeral --ignore-user-config --ignore-rules; per-run temporary CODEX_HOME containing auth.json only, removed after exit; skip_host_skill_discovery=true
actor_permissions: :minimal read; active workspace write; explicit Controller/output/auth-home deny; /tmp, /private/tmp, /var/folders and /private/var/folders denied outside active workspace; approval_policy=never; tool network=false; web_search disabled; apps/browser/computer/plugins/hooks/memory/multi_agent/history features disabled; inherit=none plus explicit system PATH /usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin
test_boundary: Native macOS Actor writes public native operation plus optional validated Actor-chosen selector into mailbox. Trusted Controller dispatcher invokes fixed executable/flags plus that validated selector in independently launched Docker container with network=none, only Actor workspace bind, no Docker socket/auth/Controller/oracle mounts. Local services and httptest can use container loopback. Hidden Judge never runs here or while Actor is alive.

linux_codex_backend.sandbox_probe_stderr: bwrap: No permissions to create a new namespace, likely because the kernel does not allow non-privileged user namespaces. On e.g. debian this can be enabled with 'sysctl kernel.unprivileged_userns_clone=1'.
linux_codex_backend.security_action: None. No sysctl, capabilities, privileged container, seccomp override, or danger-full-access fallback. Legacy Landlock cannot enforce restricted reads, so was not substituted.

interface.prepare: python3 evals/actor.py prepare --source-repo SOURCE_REPO --source-commit FULL_PRE_FIX_SHA --codekick-repo CODEKICK_REPO --problem PROBLEM_ONLY_FILE --workspace FRESH_NONEXISTENT_WORKSPACE --output CONTROLLER_PREPARATION_DIR --mailbox
interface.prepare_result: Controller preparation.json outside workspace; clean new parentless source-export .git with no remotes/unreachable/future objects; root problem.md plus frozen baseline CodeKick and non-product codekick-test client. Empty mailbox directories are ignored transport, not patch output.
interface.container: Controller boots native dependencies/services in source-free task runtime with --network none and exactly one bind: prepared workspace -> /workspace. No hidden patches/postfix/controller metadata/provider credentials in image or container. Runtime source remains pre-fix plus eventual Actor edits.
interface.operations: Controller-only JSON: fixed operation ID to either fixed argv array or {"argv":[...],"selector":{"position":N,"pattern":"REGEX","package_pattern":"OPTIONAL_REGEX"}}. Client accepts one optional Actor-chosen selector string. With package_pattern, selector is relative-package or relative-package::test-regex and dispatcher inserts package plus optional -run test-regex. Without it the native selector must match pattern. No arbitrary argv/root/env/shell. Patterns and fixed argv must not encode reference paths, hidden tests or Controller-discovered focused selectors. Paths reject absolute/traversal and workspace escape symlinks.
interface.dispatcher: python3 evals/runtime/actor/dispatcher.py --workspace PREPARED_WORKSPACE --container TRUSTED_TEST_CONTAINER --operations CONTROLLER_ONLY_OPERATIONS_JSON --output CONTROLLER_TEST_EVIDENCE_DIR --time-budget 900
interface.actor: python3 evals/actor.py run --workspace PREPARED_WORKSPACE --problem PREPARED_WORKSPACE/problem.md --preparation CONTROLLER_PREPARATION_DIR/preparation.json --output CONTROLLER_RUN_OUTPUT_DIR --label LABEL --codex INSTALLED_CODEX_CLI --deny-path CONTROLLER_ROOT --time-budget 900 [--delta EXACT_ONE_CODEKICK_PATCH]
interface.six_task_use: Repeat the same prepare/dispatcher/run config independently for each of all six frozen pre-fix environments. A/B source/problem/environment/config/time/tool budgets must match; only --delta differs. Controller records dependency/runtime image identities with dispatcher evidence. No Actor access to Docker API.

recorded_fields: completed tool-item count with explicit semantics
unknown_fields: usage if turn.completed does not expose it
tool catalogue enumeration; exec JSONL only records actual calls
prohibited_references: Detected hosted web/MCP calls, external-network references, Controller/oracle/reference/metadata paths make runs INVALID/CONTAMINATED. Synthetic probe deliberately triggers this; it never becomes a scored benchmark result.
judge: Separate Controller-side native hidden Judge only after Actor process exit and patch export. No generic Judge wrapper added; existing historical per-task runners own true tests.
claim_limits: No benchmark problem, A/B experiment, candidate, hidden Judge, functional correctness result, or benefit claim is produced by this infrastructure probe.
